name: agent-trace
description: A live, animated picture of each turn beside the chat: a map of where the work goes, a swimlane timeline and insights charts covering model steps, tool calls, subagents, hooks and permission waits

detail.title: Detail kept
detail.description: How much of each call's input is captured when no choice was made in the pane: names (file, host and program names), masked (arguments with secrets hidden and long text shortened) or full (whole arguments, kept in session memory only).

autoOpen.title: Open the pane at start
autoOpen.description: Open the Agent Trace pane when a session starts. Off, open it with /agent-trace.

keepTurns.title: Turns kept
keepTurns.description: How many recent turns the pane keeps (1 to 50).
